findings.highlight: it’d be nice to relax in here
findings.evidenceJa: ゴロゴロと居間でくつろいでもバチはあたるまい
findings.governingReading: surely no divine punishment will strike me for lazing around the living room
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-justification that relaxing will go unpunished becomes a plain statement that rest would be pleasant.

findings.highlight: I swallow the piece in my mouth
findings.governingReading: I reflexively swallow the mandarin whole
findings.explanation: The startled, unmediated gulp that answers Taiga’s teasing becomes ordinary swallowing.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what she’s doing
findings.evidenceJa: トイレだかなんだか知らないけど
findings.governingReading: Whether she is in the bathroom or wherever
findings.explanation: Shirou’s flustered and deliberately dismissive guess about Rin’s whereabouts is generalized.

findings.highlight: kick her out of the house after that
findings.evidenceJa: 余計なコトする前に家にたたき帰す
findings.governingReading: send her packing before she can do anything unnecessary
findings.explanation: The defensive implication that Shirou must remove Rin before she does something further disappears.
